title: Topological Quantization of Complex Velocity in Stochastic Spacetimes
summary: We establish a formal geometric framework for quantum fields on a stochastic gravitational background. Starting from a master partition function that averages over metric fluctuations, we define a matter amplitude $\mathcal{K}[Φ; x]$ with explicit parametric dependence on spacetime coordinates, whose logarithmic derivative yields a complex velocity field $η_μ = π_μ - i u_μ$. This object is shown to be a section of the pullback bundle $E = π_2^*(T^*M)$ over the product of configuration space $\mathcal{C}$ and spacetime $M$, and defines a flat $\mathbb{C}^\times$ connection whose $U(1)$ part…
